CustomField.description: Org ID or alias of the target org where the deployment was applied. Published by: deployment tooling. Consumed by: SmokeTestOrchestratorTrigger to set TargetOrg__c on the SmokeTestExecution__c record. Expected format: 15- or 18-character Salesforce Org ID, or a human-readable alias string up to 255 characters.
CustomField.label: Target Org
